outcome: unplanned return to the operating room (UPROR)
cohort: The study included 1198 twin pregnant women who underwent a caesarean section in China between January 2017 and December 2021.
finding: The study identified specific risk factors for postpartum haemorrhage (PPH) and unplanned return to the operating room (UPROR) in twin pregnancies after caesarean section, and developed predictive nomograms with good AUC values.
mod_finding: Emergency operation was identified as a predictor for postpartum haemorrhage (PPH) in twin pregnancies undergoing caesarean section.
birth_weight: Total birth weight was identified as a predictor for postpartum haemorrhage.
gest_age: Advanced gestational weeks were identified as a predictor for postpartum haemorrhage.
